description: Anthropic defines AI Safety Levels (ASL) as a framework for managing catastrophic risks, with ASL-2 representing current models and ASL-3 requiring stricter security and testing.

instances.assertion: Anthropic defines AI Safety Levels (ASL) as a framework for managing catastrophic risks, with ASL-2 representing current models and ASL-3 requiring stricter security and testing.
Anthropic has established a framework called AI Safety Levels (ASL) to manage catastrophic risks, modeled after biosafety levels.
